jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern (Winter Entry Cohort)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Nadora Medical Solutions is dedicated to strengthening healthcare informatics by improving daily medical workflows through collaboration and shared insights. The organization focuses on transforming complex data environments into intuitive, user-friendly solutions that support clinical teams. As a trusted service provider, Nadora works closely with healthcare partners to streamline information systems and enhance care coordination. The company’s mission is to enable medical professionals to focus more fully on patient care by optimizing data management and system usability.

Role Description

We are seeking motivated Software Engineering, Computer Science, and Data Science Interns for our 16-week Winter Entry Cohort. As an intern on our engineering and informatics team, you will bridge academic theory with real-world health IT operations. Working under the direct supervision of our Chief Project Manager, Technical Mentors, and Clinical Advisers, you will work on core platform enhancements spanning clinical data integration, AI-assisted charting safety, and patient experience portal workflows.

Key Responsibilities

Core EHR Development: Analyze clinical friction points, implement feature fixes/enhancements, write meaningful unit tests, and submit code through peer-reviewed pull requests.
Health Data Interoperability: Work with synthetic and certified de-identified datasets to prototype FHIR/HL7 data mappings, patient record matching algorithms, and data provenance checks.
Responsible Clinical AI: Research and evaluate LLM/AI charting draft modules for source fidelity, factual accuracy, omission rates, and prompt injection safety.
Patient Experience: Improve patient intake, scheduling, messaging, and web accessibility workflows based on user feedback.
Engineering Communication: Maintain design notes, ticket histories, and deliver a reproducible capstone presentation at the end of the cohort.

Minimum Qualifications

Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Health Informatics, or a related field.
Strong foundational programming skills (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, SQL, or REST APIs).
Familiarity with version control systems (Git/GitHub) and testing frameworks.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior coursework or project experience in database design, machine learning, web accessibility, or health informatics.
Interest in medical software safety, HIPAA compliance, or digital health technology.

jobs.title: Software Developer Engineer Test [AQ-24839]
jobs.description:
Aquent, a global leader in talent solutions, is proud to partner with an innovative and influential organization that is pioneering the use of artificial intelligence to transform its industry. This company is dedicated to building robust, reliable, and cutting-edge AI-powered applications that deliver significant impact for users and stakeholders. Join a team where your expertise will directly shape the future of AI technology, ensuring that groundbreaking solutions are not only innovative but also reliable, accurate, and production-ready, ultimately enhancing user trust and enabling the scalable delivery of AI-powered features across strategic initiatives.

Are you ready to be at the forefront of AI innovation? This is a pivotal opportunity to join a forward-thinking team where your expertise will directly shape the future of AI technology. As a key contributor, you will be instrumental in designing, automating, and executing advanced testing strategies for AI-powered applications, machine learning systems, intelligent agents, copilots, and generative AI solutions. By blending your strong software quality engineering background with cutting-edge AI validation techniques, you will ensure our AI systems are not only innovative but also reliable, accurate, performant, and production-ready, ultimately enhancing user trust and enabling the scalable delivery of AI-powered features across strategic initiatives. Your work will directly impact the quality and trustworthiness of AI solutions that will redefine industry standards.

What You Will Do

Develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies for a diverse portfolio of AI applications, platforms, and services.
Validate AI model outputs for critical attributes such as accuracy, consistency, reliability, and safety, ensuring high-quality user experiences.
Design and execute a full spectrum of tests including functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and performance testing for AI solutions.
Create sophisticated test cases tailored for prompt-driven, agentic, and retrieval-based AI workflows.
Validate AI guardrails, business rules, permissions, and governance controls to ensure responsible AI deployment.
Perform adversarial, negative, and edge-case testing to proactively identify potential model failures and hallucinations.
Build and maintain robust automated test frameworks specifically designed for AI applications, streamlining the testing process.
Develop automated evaluation pipelines for AI responses and workflows, facilitating continuous quality assessment.
Integrate AI testing seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines, promoting a culture of continuous quality and rapid iteration.
Implement automated quality scoring and regression detection mechanisms to maintain high standards across releases.
Create reusable test data, mocks, simulators, and validation frameworks to enhance testing efficiency and coverage.
Test AI agents, workflows, APIs, and tool-calling capabilities, ensuring smooth and effective operations.
Validate integrations with external systems, diverse data sources, and enterprise services.
Verify the performance, reliability, scalability, and resiliency of AI workloads through rigorous testing.
Execute load and stress testing to ensure AI services can handle anticipated demands.
Collaborate closely with software engineers, AI engineers, product owners, architects, and security teams throughout the development lifecycle.
Actively participate in design reviews, providing crucial quality feedback from the early stages of development.
Contribute to defining test strategy, establishing quality standards, and promoting best practices across the organization.
Support production readiness reviews and lead defect triage activities to ensure timely resolution of issues.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
3–6 years of progressive experience in software testing, QA automation, or quality engineering.
Proven experience developing automated test solutions using one or more of the following languages: Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#.
Demonstrated experience with API testing and automation tools (e.g., Postman).
Strong foundational understanding of test automation principles and best practices.
Solid grasp of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
Experience integrating testing into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
Experience testing distributed systems, web applications, and APIs.
Familiarity with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.
Experience with testing on cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Proficiency in quality engineering concepts including Defect Analysis and Root Cause Investigation.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Experience testing generative AI applications, LLM-based systems, AI agents, or RAG applications.
Familiarity with leading AI models and platforms such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or Azure OpenAI.
Experience building evaluation and benchmarking frameworks specifically for AI solutions.
Knowledge of responsible AI principles, AI governance frameworks, and AI risk management practices.
Experience with AI-specific testing techniques including Prompt Testing, Response Evaluation, Hallucination Detection, Agent Workflow Validation, RAG Validation, AI Safety Testing, AI Regression Testing, and AI Benchmarking.
Familiarity with test automation frameworks like Selenium, Playwright, JUnit, or PyTest.
Exposure to various quality engineering domains such as Performance Testing, Load Testing, and Security Testing.

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Program Overview

Improves sustainment efforts for new enhancements and capabilities while maintaining operational applications and their authority to operate. Program supports research, development, testing, and evaluation based on customer requirements and agile processes, while assisting with intelligence missions and global integration efforts.

About The Role

Peraton's Defense Intelligence Solutions (DIS) business unit has a need for an experienced Front End Software Engineer
to support its SITE III DO contract charged with the orchestration, sustainment, and evolution of a portfolio of mission critical applications and services supporting a major Directorate within the U.S. Intelligence Community (IC). The SITE III DO contract is designed to establish and ensure a multi-discipline approach to requirements engineering, solutions engineering, scheduling, reliability, resiliency, services development, integration, test and evaluation, maintainability and analysis across the National apparatus of Defense Intelligence, Combatant Commands, supporting Partner Nations and other Federal Agencies to ensure timely and accurate Human Intelligence (HUMINT) collection, correlation and dissemination. Our support team applies best practices in architecture design, data science, cloud services, DevSecOps and platform integration to develop, sustain and continually evolve the global U.S. human intelligence apparatus and supporting partners. This role is fully on-site
in Indian Head, MD
.

The Front End Software Engineer

Designs, develops, documents, tests and debugs applications software and systems that contain logical and mathematical solutions.

Experience with Spring Boot, Java

Job Description

Domino’s continues its journey towards the dominant #1 Pizza Company in the world and sound data is the most fundamental of assets that helps us drive towards that. To help accelerate our drive, we are looking for a driven Databricks Data Platform Engineer to join our team at World Resource Center (WRC) in Ann Arbor, MI.

Main Responsibilities

Administer and support Databricks workspaces, clusters, jobs, runtimes, compute policies, SQL Warehouses, and platform configurations.
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues involving cluster instability, failed/slow jobs, performance bottlenecks, connectivity issues, resource constraints, and platform availability.
Manage Databricks governance and security, including Entra ID/AAD groups, service principals, permissions, secrets, Unity Catalog, and workspace access.
Perform performance and cost optimization, including cluster sizing, autoscaling, Photon, workload optimization, compute policies, and cloud cost reduction.
Develop and maintain CI/CD, automation, job orchestration, and Infrastructure-as Code solutions using tools such as Azure DevOps and Terraform.
Collaborate with Data Engineering, DataOps, Infrastructure, Security, DBA, and vendor teams to resolve production issues and support platform operations.
Participate in incident management, change/release processes, root cause analysis (RCA), and continuous improvement activities.
Create and maintain operational runbooks, support documentation, and standard operating procedures.
Take ownership of production issues and independently drive them through troubleshooting, resolution, and follow-up actions.
Good to have SQL Server and MongoDB administration/support experience, with the ability to troubleshoot platform issues as needed and collaborate effectively with required teams.

Qualifications

5+ years of hands-on experience with Azure Databricks administration and L2/L3 production support.
Strong hands-on cloud experience, preferably Azure, including networking, storage, identity/access, security, monitoring, and Databricks integration.
Proven experience troubleshooting complex production issues involving Databricks performance, connectivity, availability, jobs, and resource constraints.
Strong communication, ownership, and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently drive issues to resolution.
Good to have: Hands-on experience with SQL Server and MongoDB administration.
Work Location: Ability to work onsite 4 days per week at the main office in Ann Arbor, MI.

Additional Information

Benefits:

Paid Holidays and Vacation  
Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment
No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents
Childcare tuition discounts
No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs
Fertility benefits
Adoption assistance
401k matching contributions  
15% off the purchase price of stock  
Company bonus  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
